items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Something like Tootsie or Tina or? Tina. Tina, yeah, that was it. I can't remember. Yeah, Tina. Yeah.

ctx.x: I didn't see Paul much. I knew his wife there, and, uh, what, what, uh, what, uh, what was the name, I can't remember. His wife? Yeah.
Something like Tootsie or Tina or? Tina. Tina, yeah, that was it. I can't remember. Yeah, Tina. Yeah.

But, I mean, I, I was, uh, you see, working at the, at the, at the Blackhawk, we, we, we played about the same time that they, they had their, they going over there, see. And, uh, of course, after we got through at night, we'd get through about two o'clock in the morning. So, it was, by the time we lived, we left the, up around, on, on, on, on, on, on, on, on the north side there by the, by the, that was the name of a hotel. What, uh, what street?
